authors: Yuqin Cao; Xiongkuo Min; Yixuan Gao; Wei Sun; Guangtao Zhai
independent_acceptance: focused scientific check completed; scientific adjudication pending

problems.title: Printed level score direction contradicts highest-score selection
problems.evidence: Finite-logit excellent/bad example reverses scores; corrected mapping6-S verified.
problems.counterreading: Release wa5 correctly weights excellent highest; historical baseline path unavailable.
problems.repair_status: Local mathematical repair verified; historical scores unverified

independent_check.original_and_assumptions: Read original p8 Eq1 and highest-score choice in Section5.4, and p15 B.1 rating anchors. The excellent-to-bad order and larger-is-better score direction are explicit.
independent_check.independent_derivation: For E=exp(8), excellent-concentrated printed score=(E+14)/(E+4), bad-concentrated score=(5E+10)/(E+4). A fresh math evaluation returned1.0033501309041575 and4.996649869095843. Replacing each weight i by6-i gives6-S and reverses the incorrect order. Exponentiating probabilities instead of logits would change values but not the directional contradiction.
independent_check.counterevidence_and_scope: Directly read released wa5 lines63-71: weights[1,.75,.5,.25,0] give the correct direction. This helper alone is not the historical baseline evaluation path; regression inference does not establish every compared method used Eq1.
independent_check.severity_and_repair: Minor specification defect retained; historical impact is Needs Evidence. Local reverse-weight repair proved; published model rankings are not refuted.

problems.title: Correlation loss differs between equation and release
problems.evidence: Idealized release loss=(3-2rho-rho^2)/8 rather than (1-rho)/2; same optimum but different gradients.

independent_check.original_and_assumptions: Read p18 Eq3 and directly inspected plcc_loss lines44-52. Assume nonconstant standardized vectors and explicitly ignore the1e-8 stabilizers, as the report does.
independent_check.independent_derivation: Population-standardized a,b have E[a^2]=E[b^2]=1 and E[ab]=rho. First MSE/4=(2-2rho)/4; second MSE(rho*a,b)/4=(rho^2+1-2rho^2)/4=(1-rho^2)/4. Their mean is(3-2rho-rho^2)/8. At rho=0 it is3/8 rather than1/2; derivative=-(1+rho)/4, while both have minimum at rho=1. Positive-affine prediction invariance proves that a correlation objective alone does not identify MOS calibration.
independent_check.counterevidence_and_scope: Finite epsilon and low variance perturb the idealized identity; it is not claimed exact for degenerate vectors. Same optimum is retained and no failed training or measured RMSE is inferred. Global tensor reduction is a release fact, historical dimension-wise training protocol unresolved.
independent_check.severity_and_repair: Minor release-description mismatch retained. Documenting the actual objective or changing implementation requires the historical training revision; no retraining or end-to-end repair verified.

problems.title: Pretraining component counts sum to50592, not50952

independent_check.original_and_assumptions: Read p5 Section4/4.1: headline50,952 and mutually named audio-video25,592/audio-text19,000/music-text6,000 components.
independent_check.independent_derivation: 25,592+19,000=44,592; plus6,000=50,592, leaving360 between sum and headline. This is a source numerical inconsistency, not a recovered missing subset.
independent_check.counterevidence_and_scope: A transposed digit in either the total or a component is possible. No construction manifest identifies which number reflects actual training and no measurable training effect follows.
independent_check.severity_and_repair: Minor numerical provenance discrepancy retained. Correct total/components from the actual construction manifest; do not invent360 examples or assert dataset corruption.

limitations: Historical baseline paths, folds and raw ratings unavailable.
repair_verification: Local score direction/loss algebra verified; empirical impact unverified
